name: TweetEval
description: TweetEval is a unified evaluation framework consisting of seven heterogeneous Twitter-specific classification tasks designed to standardize and compare performance on social media NLP tasks such as sentiment analysis, irony detection, and emoji prediction.
reputation: TweetEval is a well-known and widely used benchmark for Twitter/social-media NLP classification tasks and is commonly used for standardized comparison across models.
notes: Includes seven heterogeneous Twitter-specific classification tasks and provides strong baselines and comparisons of language model pre-training strategies.
